description: This PHP file defines the class OAuth2ClientsViewDetail, which extends ViewDetail and manages the display of detailed views for OAuth2 client records within the SuiteCRM platform. It includes methods for setting view types based on grant types, retrieving metadata files, and customizing display behavior.

classes.name: OAuth2ClientsViewDetail
classes.description: A class extending ViewDetail to handle the detailed view of OAuth2 client records, including logic for setting view types based on grant types.

methods.name: getMetaDataFile
methods.description: Overrides the method to set the view type before retrieving metadata file path.

methods.name: setViewType
methods.description: Determines the view type and form name based on the 'allowed_grant_type' property of the bean.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Overrides parent display method to set the form name before rendering the view.
